items.name: Cloak of Resistance +1
items.description: This garment offers magic protection in the form of a +1 to +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (Fortitude, Reflex, and Will).

items.name: Wack Juce
items.description:
Refreshingly intoxicating, Wack Juce is made with the finest synthetic oranges in Numeria, and the 3rd finest potato vodka in the world: Smashka Noble!
Enjoy this sweet and soothing taste of home, you can almost hear the anthem of the Fatherland as you slurp!

items.name: Corona Laser Pistol
items.description: Laser pistols are light and reliable, yet they still deal a respectable amount of damage.

items.name: Carbon Steel Curved Blade
items.description:
Compatible Proficiency: Cutlass, Scimitar, Falchion, Longsword.

 

Advanced alloy & construction process causes this blade to pierce DR as an adamantine weapon.  It's creation process is impossible with any known tech or craftsmen on Golarion.

 

This graceful, curving blade further increases the drama inherent in sword fighting.
